scope: Packaged Windows desktop readability; no location-accuracy claim

baseline.observed: Windows light mode replaced the styled controls with a white sidebar and black text on fixed dark panels. Requirements and progress text became difficult to read.

fix.change: Set the egui theme to Dark before applying the workbench style, so later system-theme events preserve consistent text and controls.
fix.observed: The exact packaged candidate keeps a dark sidebar and readable white text after startup and after waiting for system-theme updates.

preserved_harness_failure.reason: The visual harness expected the branch commit instead of GitHub's PR test-merge commit and stopped before launching the app.
preserved_harness_failure.correction: Verify the test-merge parents and matching source tree, then pin the observed commit and EXE hash.

execution: Resource-limited WSL2 and GitHub Windows/Linux VMs; no host application execution
